Game Overview

At its heart, Capybara Zen is a platformer game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Getting started in Capybara Zen doesn't take long to learn. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Capybara Zen?

Capybara Zen is a free platformer game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Capybara Zen free to play?

Yes, Capybara Zen is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
